source.method: five full-width browser screenshots supplied by the owner; pixel sampling and cap-height measurement; page HTML for the 56rem container class

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground (sampled everywhere outside cards).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Feature cards and the hero panel (sampled #efefef).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Format tiles, the tour tab track and thumbnail wells (sampled #f3f3f3 / #f2f2f2).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Active tab, floating mini-UI, round carousel buttons (sampled #fffffd).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, first line of two-tone heads (sampled). 18.0:1 on `ground`.

tokens.name: ink-button
tokens.usage: Primary buttons: warm near-black (sampled #181614). `paper` text 18.0:1.

tokens.name: ink-title
tokens.usage: Card titles and button labels on grey (sampled). 12.3:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Hero paragraph and section subtext (sampled). 4.9:1 on `ground`, 4.5:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: ink-nav
tokens.usage: Nav links (sampled). 6.5:1 on `ground`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Card descriptions, microcopy and tagline (sampled). 4.3:1 on `ground`, 4.0:1 on `card`: below AA at 12px, the site's own pairing.

tokens.name: ink-quiet
tokens.usage: Footer links (sampled). 3.8:1 on `ground`: below AA, the site's own pairing; keep to non-essential links.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Second line of two-tone headlines (sampled #939393). 2.9:1 on `ground`: just under 3:1 even at headline size; keep for the decorative second line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines (footer rule, segmented control edge; sampled #e5e6e3 / #ebebeb).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Small tag chips and the Opt-in pill (sampled #dcdcdc). Pill text needs `ink-nav` or darker: #929292 on it is only 2.3:1.

tokens.name: grey-button
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (sampled #eeeeee).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Selection ring on thumbnails and the send button in mini-UI (sampled #4078e8 / #4878d0). 4.1:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Folder glyph in the Research chip (sampled). Graphic only.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Feather glyph in the Writing chip (sampled). Graphic only.

tokens.name: ph-red
tokens.usage: Product Hunt mark in the badge (sampled from a 24px glyph, so approximate).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and section headlines; cap height measured 25px.

styles.name: display-soft
styles.usage: Second line of a two-tone headline, in `ink-faint`.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Hero paragraph and section subtext; lines measured 21px apart.
styles.sample: Save notes, bookmarks, screenshots and PDFs in one local library.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between cards (measured 7–8px) and button pair.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav link gap; footer link rhythm (24px line pitch).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side padding inside the container.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Container max width (56rem, from the page HTML).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Feature cards (read from corners, estimated).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons (estimated).

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Nav Get Resurf button (estimated).

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Product screenshots (estimated).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tabs, pills, chips, carousel buttons.

radius.note: Radii are read by eye from corners at about 1:1; treat them as ±2px.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating mini-UI inside feature cards. Estimated from soft shadows in the art.

tokens.name: shadow-image
tokens.usage: Under the large product screenshot; the sampled column fades from #cccfd9 to #f2f2f2 over about 50px.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: Active segmented tab. Estimated.
